item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "e1a610a7d9a1613c3eecf1cd3ee8bceb37ea0613711d214b0a0adf46c697d6bc",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "For a function q: R × R → E and real speed v, at every real pair (x,t), both coordinate derivatives exist and satisfy q_t(x,t) + v • q_x(x,t) = 0, as specified by LocalDef008.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires pointwise transport at speed -c for p - density*c*u, and gives the transport predicate occurring in the profile differentiability equivalence.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "For q and flux F, every spatial slice is interval integrable on every finite interval, every time slice F(q(x,·)) is interval integrable on every finite interval, and for all real a,b,s,t, integral_a^b q(x,t) dx - integral_a^b q(x,s) dx = integral_s^t [F(q(a,τ)) - F(q(b,τ))] dτ.",
      "effect_on_target": "The final equivalence uses this exact integral balance predicate with q(x,t)=profile(x+c*t) and F(z)=-c*z.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "A type indexed by two real parameters. Its supplied constructor packages nonzero density, real-valued pressure and velocity fields, and the pointwise derivative conditions of LocalDef010.",
      "effect_on_target": "The theorem universally quantifies over such a supplied system; its pressure and velocity enter the transport conclusion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "The second field of the system, its function pressure: R → R → R.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies p(x,t) in p(x,t)-density*c*u(x,t).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "The third field of the system, its function velocity: R → R → R.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies u(x,t) in p(x,t)-density*c*u(x,t).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "Maps pressure p, velocity u, density ρ and soundSpeed c to the function (x,t) ↦ p(x,t)-(ρ*c)*u(x,t).",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the precise field combination whose transport speed is -c.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "LocalDef007",
      "meaning": "For any profile f: R → E and speed v, defines (x,t) ↦ f(x-v*t).",
      "effect_on_target": "At v=-c this is f(x+c*t); evaluating it at (x-c*t,t) returns f(x).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "LocalDef008",
      "meaning": "At the specified x,t, there exist qt,qx in E such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative qt at t, ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) has derivative qx at x, and qt+speed • qx=0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Derivative witnesses are chosen separately at each point. For scalar fields at speed -c, the equation is qt-c*qx=0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "LocalDef009",
      "meaning": "Constructs a system at parameters K,ρ from a proof ρ≠0, fields p,u: R → R → R, and a proof of LocalDef010 p u K ρ x t for every real x,t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Exposes the nonzero-density and pointwise system-equation content carried by the system binder.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "LocalDef010",
      "meaning": "There exist real pt,px,ut,ux witnessing the time and spatial derivatives of p and u at (x,t), respectively, with pt+K*ux=0 and ut+ρ⁻¹*px=0.",
      "effect_on_target": "The system provides these derivative witnesses and both equations at every point; they are assumptions carried by the input system.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "LocalDef011",
      "meaning": "Scalar multiplication is jointly continuous for any real normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies structural continuity required by derivative predicates, without imposing an additional condition on the fields.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "LocalDef012",
      "meaning": "Real scalar multiplication on R is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the continuity instance for the scalar system derivative predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction: both propositions hold.",
      "effect_on_target": "All listed conclusions hold together; derivative and integrability conditions within the definitions are also conjunctive.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed field structure and derives nontriviality of the norm from dense norm values.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real scalar-field structure used by differentiability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Differentiable",
      "meaning": "A function is differentiable over the specified scalar field at every point of its domain.",
      "effect_on_target": "Differentiable Real profile means ordinary real differentiability everywhere on R, without continuity of the derivative.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "DivInvMonoid.toDiv",
      "meaning": "Extracts the division operation from a division-and-inverse monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real division in K/ρ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality between two elements of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "All displayed identities are exact equalities, not approximations or almost-everywhere equalities.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts an instance's addition operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Denotes ordinary real addition in the profile arguments and scalar equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "HDiv.hDiv",
      "meaning": "Extracts an instance's division operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms the real quotient K/ρ defining c.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "HMul.hMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts an instance's multiplication operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Denotes ordinary real multiplication in speeds, fluxes, field combinations and coordinate shifts.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Extracts an instance's subtraction operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Denotes subtraction in coordinate shifts, the field combination and integral balances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "Iff",
      "meaning": "Logical equivalence, requiring both implications.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both the differentiability and interval-integrability characterizations are necessary and sufficient conditions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed vector-space structure of an inner-product space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real normed-space structure for scalar transport and integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "IntervalIntegrable",
      "meaning": "Requires integrability on both (a,b] and (b,a] with respect to the given measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Handles either ordering of endpoints; universal real endpoints require integrability on every bounded interval.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "Extracts the strict-order relation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses strict positivity of K,ρ and c.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume",
      "meaning": "Extracts the designated measure of a measure-space instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "All integrability and integration use the designated real volume measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "Neg.neg",
      "meaning": "Extracts additive negation.",
      "effect_on_target": "The transport speed and flux coefficient are the negative real number -c.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplication commutativity from a nonunital seminormed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the inherited real analytic structure; changes no operation or domain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive commutative group and pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive analytic structure used by real differentiability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group and metric while forgetting additive commutativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the norm structure used in scalar integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, addition and induced pseudometric of a normed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a weaker structural interface on the same real space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Equips a normed additive group with its associated extended nonnegative norm and additive-monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows the integrability predicates to use the usual real absolute-value size.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, commutative ring operations and induced pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited real structures for differentiation without changing the proposition's domain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure of a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real-linear scalar multiplication for derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number literal through its supplied instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "The literal 0 is real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the usual real metric to the topology used in differentiability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal",
      "meaning": "Equips an RCLike field with its real inner-product structure and associated real normed-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "At R this supplies the ordinary real vector-space structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The type of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Parameters, coordinates, times, endpoints, profiles, field values and derivative witnesses are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real normed-field structure together with density of its norm values.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports ordinary real differential calculus.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Real addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes addition in x+c*t and all scalar sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative-group structure on R.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies addition, zero and additive inverses in the analytic predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "Real.instDivInvMonoid",
      "meaning": "Real multiplication, inverse and division, with division equal to multiplication by the inverse.",
      "effect_on_target": "K/ρ means K*ρ⁻¹; positivity ensures the denominator is nonzero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "The strict order on R.",
      "effect_on_target": "All positivity statements use the usual real ordering.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "Real multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "All products in the scalar target have their ordinary real meaning.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "Real.instNeg",
      "meaning": "Real additive negation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes -c the negative of the positive square root.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "Real.instRCLike",
      "meaning": "The real RCLike structure, with identity real-part map, zero imaginary-part map, and the usual complete normed-field and real-algebra structures.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies standard real analytic structures; does not introduce complex-valued variables.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "Real.instSub",
      "meaning": "Real subtraction defined by a-b=a+(-b).",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes signs in the transported combination, shifts and flux differences.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The real number zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the comparison baseline and the zero right-hand sides of equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "Real.measureSpace",
      "meaning": "The standard real measure-space instance, whose volume is Lebesgue measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Integrability and interval integrals are Lebesgue integrability and oriented Lebesgue integrals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "R with its ordinary additive group, absolute-value norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the scalar analytic setting of transport and integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The usual commutative real ring with its absolute-value norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies compatible algebraic and analytic structures for real differentiability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field with its usual norm and metric, including totalized inversion with inverse zero equal to zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar calculus and division structure; zero inversion is irrelevant under positive density.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real pseudometric d(x,y)=|x-y| and its associated uniformity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the ordinary real topology used for derivatives and integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Real.sqrt",
      "meaning": "Takes the nonnegative square root after truncating the real argument to its nonnegative part.",
      "effect_on_target": "Since K/ρ>0, c is its ordinary positive square root; the zero value on negative arguments is not exercised.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the multiplicative-unit requirements while retaining norm, ring operations and pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "A structural conversion on R with no additional mathematical assumption.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology of a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses the topology inherited from the usual real metric.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 as the zero supplied by a Zero instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures positivity hypotheses compare against real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary addition as same-type heterogeneous addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "No change to real addition in the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "instHDiv",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary division as same-type heterogeneous division.",
      "effect_on_target": "No change to real division in K/ρ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "instHMul",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary multiplication as same-type heterogeneous multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "No change to real products in the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "instHSub",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary subtraction as same-type heterogeneous subtraction.",
      "effect_on_target": "No change to scalar subtraction or integral differences.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition, subtraction and negation structure from an additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports subtraction in the vector-valued definition of integral balance, specialized here to R.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "A commutative additive group equipped with a norm and compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "The general definitions permit such codomains, but the target specializes the codomain to R.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive group of a normed additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the subtraction operations used in integral balance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "NormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A module over a normed field with scalar multiplication compatible with the norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real vector-space setting for derivatives and integrals; no variable abstract space remains in the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric from a seminormed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the topology for the generic analytic definitions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "SubNegMonoid.toSub",
      "meaning": "Extracts subtraction from a subtraction-and-negation monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides subtraction between integrals and flux values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "intervalIntegral",
      "meaning": "The integral over (a,b] minus the integral over (b,a], with respect to the supplied measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "All balance integrals are oriented; endpoints need not be increasing and equal endpoints give zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Builds a commutative subtraction-monoid structure from an additive commutative group, preserving its operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports inherited subtraction, negation and zero in derivative equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "AddCommMagma.toAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition from a commutative additive magma.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies addition for the general transport equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Forgets the zero element requirement while retaining associative commutative addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the structural path to addition in derivative equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma",
      "meaning": "Retains the addition operation and commutativity from an additive commutative semigroup.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves addition used in the transport predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains addition and its zero identity from an additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports zero and scalar-action structures in derivative equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "AddZero.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts the zero element from an addition-with-zero structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the zero in general vector-valued transport equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "AddZeroClass.toAddZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition and zero from a structure asserting the zero identity laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the additive zero used by the transport predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul",
      "meaning": "Retains a scalar action and its preservation of zero and addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports multiplication of the spatial derivative by the speed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Extracts a scalar action preserving zero from a distributive scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the inherited real scalar multiplication used in transport.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets definiteness of the extended norm while retaining the seminormed additive commutative-monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a structural interface for integrability without altering real size or addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative monoid from an extended-seminormed additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides addition and zero used by the analytic definitions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets additive commutativity while retaining the extended seminorm and additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "A structural conversion with no change to the target's real operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid from an extended-seminormed additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports addition and zero in the generic definitions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over an element satisfying the given predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Derivative values are existential witnesses at each point; there is no top-level existential claim constructing a system or profile.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from an instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "The expression speed • qx specializes to the real product speed*qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "Asserts that a one-variable function has the specified derivative at the specified point, using its full neighborhood.",
      "effect_on_target": "The field predicates require actual coordinate derivatives at every point, not merely values of a total derivative operator or one-sided derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action from a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar action multiplying the spatial derivative by the speed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "Ne",
      "meaning": "Inequality, defined as negated equality.",
      "effect_on_target": "The system constructor requires density≠0, already implied by the target's positive-density hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
      "name": "NegZeroClass.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts zero from a structure with negation preserving zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the zero in the general derivative equation.",
